reasoning_content: Defaults are pre-filled (user ID claim=name, display name=name, email=email). I'll just POST with the defaults. Submitting step 3 → redirects to /admin/login/start?mode=bootstrap (Dex OIDC login).

action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
CSRF=$(sed 's/csrf=//' csrf3.txt)
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt -e "http://localhost:8080/admin/bootstrap" --max-time 15 \
  --data-urlencode "_csrf_token=$CSRF" \
  --data-urlencode "oidc_user_id_claim=name" \
  --data-urlencode "oidc_displayname_claim=name" \
  --data-urlencode "oidc_email_claim=email" \
  --data-urlencode "matrix_oidc_extra_scopes=" \
  --data-urlencode "admin_oidc_extra_scopes=" \
  --data-urlencode "matrix_oidc_refresh_mode=offline" \
  --data-urlencode "admin_oidc_refresh_mode=online" \
  -o step3_resp.html -D step3_headers.txt -w "step3 POST: [%{http_code}]\n" http://localhost:8080/admin/bootstrap/step/3
grep -i location step3_headers.txt
